signals_info.description: Time headway from the ego vehicle to the selected lead vehicle during moving ACC car-following.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall be greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，与前车的时间车头时距应大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During ACC car-following, the vehicle shall always maintain a time headway of more than 2 seconds to the lead vehicle.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: ACC 跟车过程中，车辆与前车应始终保持大于 2 秒的时间车头时距。
